Game Overview

In Christmas Puzzle, the core idea is straightforward: unleash festive fun with Christmas Puzzle. Connect identical Christmas-themed objects to score big. As the pace quickens, channel your reflexes to craft larger chains and rack up points. Play solo or challenge friends, all within a vibrant, festive atmosphere that keeps you coming back for more.
